text: The cooling design shall be based on the maximum ambient dry-bulb temperature for full capability of 40 degC (DP-CASE-0008) and the site summer design condition (0.4 %, DP-OWNR-0001) for comfort cooling load calculations of buildings with a 10 % safety margin; equipment (air-cooled chillers, condensers, fans) shall be rated to give the required capacity at 40 degC and shall operate without damage at the survival range (-15 degC to +45 degC, DP-CASE-0009); the capacity derating between 40 degC and 45 degC shall be stated by the chiller supplier.
